name: Capture ↔ Deposit Link Map
description: Edges between EA-WG-CAPTURES-01 (the AI Overview / AI Mode Capture Registry, authored at machinemediation.org) and the Alexanarch deposit corpus. Produced by scripts/resolve_capture_links.py. Each edge records the resolution method so any confidence tier can be discarded. An edge asserts that the capture entry references, or its query matches, the deposit — not that the deposit is the capture's sole subject; exactly one edge per capture is marked primary, ranked by evidence of aboutness rather than by identifier hardness (a DOI can be cited in passing). Deposit-number mentions are deliberately excluded as unsafe. Unresolved captures are enumerated rather than silently dropped.

severance_rollup.CORRECTION: The first published rollup (2026-07-25) reported 92% of DOI-bearing captured works as severed. That figure was an artefact of the estimator, which binned a capture as severed if ANY status in its list contained 410 and as unsevered only if none did; deposits commonly carry several DOIs with mixed statuses. Corrected below by comparing status counts against the base rate of the same identifier population.
severance_rollup.finding: NULL. Captured works are not enriched for severance (49.2% vs 52.2% base). The severance hypothesis is not supported at this sample size.
